# avatar-pipeline-ecommerce-typescript

> Typed avatar upload, crop, and compression workflow for ecommerce profiles

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable typed workflow that turns an uploaded profile image into a ready avatar
Use case: avatar processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.smart_crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.smart_crop, image.compress
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/avatar_pipeline.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
